title: Final _judged.jsonl record
description: One record per (case_id, trial). Produced by judge_responses (judge/runner.py). The runner reads strategies_post_review and emits this prod-shape record.

options.description: Per-rubric-option verdict after review overrides applied.

harm.description: Per-option harm records (only options with harm_type set).

metrics.description: Per-record metrics from compute_metrics_for_case (judge/metrics.py); apply_length_correction additionally writes the pre-correction *_raw values and response_len.

F1_weighted.description: Headline: matched (off-rubric excluded) severity-weighted F1, zeroed when a Severe harm fired (Severe cap); recall-only length correction.

F1_uncapped.description: Pre-2026-06 headline: severity-weighted partial F1, off-rubric included, no Severe cap. Kept as a comparison metric; full P+R length correction.

Precision_matched.description: Severity-weighted partial precision over rubric-matched actions only (off-rubric excluded); NaN when no action matched the rubric. Composes F1_weighted with Recall_weighted.

Offrubric_rate.description: Fraction of the model's actions that matched no rubric option; NaN when the model took no action.

F1_weighted_raw.description: Pre-length-correction F1_weighted; apply_length_correction keeps the uncorrected value.

response_len.description: Char count used for length correction; mirrors the top-level field.

runtime.description: Always null; the strategy pipeline doesn't track per-judge wall-clock at this layer (cost lives in per-stage outputs).

grader_usage.description: Always null at this layer; see per-stage usage.
